question: What is still unread on the oracle, so the facts outlive the trial?
how: From every item's evidence and every finding's notRead, notMeasured, inferred and unexplained lines on main at c71aebf. An entry is left out if it is under decision 0005, or a builder holds its item: T4, T9, T15, T12 (blocks); P5, U10, U12 (chrome); R2, X8, X2, phone order, H3 (gestures). Found by text search plus reading, so a fact nobody wrote down as unread is not here. Entries with source CAP-COVERAGE.json come from the coverage walk: parity/coverage-check.json lists them, npm run coverage-check compares.
safeRead: yes: can be read on a probe page, unsaved. no: why says what stops it.
